'''Cray Linlok''' was a [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] on [[Rinagom]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] at the [[Galactic Rim/Legends|Rimward]] fringe of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. Headquartered at [[Dulan Field Harvesting Center]], Linlok was known to be particularly harsh, abusing employees and utilizing indentured servitude to maximize the production of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]]. Due to the planet's relative isolation, the working conditions on the planet were scarcely known about.<ref name="KtP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cray Linlok was first mentioned in a campaign concept in ''[[Keeping the Peace]]'', a sourcebook for the [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Guardian]] specialization in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[roleplaying game]]<ref name="KtP" /> released on [[December 17]] [[2015]].<ref name="KtP release date">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2015/12/17/now-is-your-chance|text=Now Is Your Chance}}</ref> In the campaign concept, player characters would visit the planet Rinagom and meet Linlok as part of a supply delivery and would discover the conditions of the workforce in the planet's agricultural industry. Characters would then instigate an employee revolt against Linlok, or attempt to cause the CSA itself to remove Linlok from power by gathering evidence of wrongdoing.<ref name="KtP" />
